title: Comparing Behavioral vs Activation Monitoring Latency for Real-Time Agent Control

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Useful engineering benchmark comparing latency vs accuracy tradeoffs. Practical value is clear but the insight is more systems-engineering than safety-science.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires instrumenting an agent loop with two different monitoring systems, implementing activation probe extraction in real-time, and benchmarking latency. Significant engineering for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Building a working agent loop with two monitoring backends and benchmarking both is a substantial engineering project. 50 tasks with wall-clock measurement requires careful infrastructure. Likely exceeds 30 hours for beginners.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
